summary: Cycle 2 deep analysis confirms Until/Since sorries CANNOT be closed with current formula. Formula.untl compat_disj Formula.top is provably too weak — NfComposition.lean counterexample shows 1-var NF compositionality is FALSE on linear orders. Requires architectural change: generalize ExistPart to non-constant parent environments.

blockers.description: Until/Since backward directions require a FORMULA CHANGE, not just a proof technique. The current formula (Formula.untl compat_disj Formula.top) encodes only predicate-level compatibility at the 1-var level. The backward direction needs full depth-(k'+1+1) arity-2 NF evaluation, which involves depth-(k'+1) arity-3 quantifier conditions for the non-constant parent env [x,t].
blockers.root_cause: ExistPart as defined only handles constant parent env (fun _ => t). The 3-var existentials in the Until/Since zones have parent env [x,t] where x != t, which ExistPart cannot encode. NfComposition.lean contains a formal proof (with counterexample on Z) that 1-var NF compositionality is FALSE for general linear orders, including Prior structures.
what_was_tried: ih_exist at n=2 with constant parent: WORKS for Eq zone, FAILS for Until/Since
nf_extend_fwd/bwd cross-structure transfer: loses one depth level (K+1 -> K), cannot reach target depth
intra_structure_extend: requires arity-n agreement at K+1 to produce arity-(n+1) at K, but establishing arity-n at K+1 IS the goal — circular
General compositionality theorem (same 1-var types + ordering => same n-var type): DISPROVED by NfComposition.lean counterexample (Z with (0,2) vs (0,1))
Prior structure UZ/SZ exploitation: these give no-gap properties but don't resolve the between-zone element availability issue
EF game composition (GHR93): exists in Composition.lean but uses ExtendedCarrier/StaviFormula framework, incompatible with NormalForm/nf_eval_nf
blockers.what_is_needed:
One of three architectural changes (ordered by estimated difficulty):
  (A) Generalize ExistPart to handle non-constant parent environments (parent env: Fin m -> M.carrier instead of fun _ => t). This would allow encoding Until/Since quantifier conditions directly. Estimated: ~400-600 lines new code.
  (B) Port the k=0 VecEA2/bracket formula approach to depth k'+1 using ih_char instead of nf_depth0_char_formula. This would generalize the zone-by-zone encoding to higher depth. Estimated: ~800-1200 lines (mirrors the existing ~1000 lines per direction).
  (C) Reformulate the mutual induction to avoid the Until/Since backward direction entirely, e.g., by proving ExistPart at all arities simultaneously using a different induction scheme. Estimated: ~300-500 lines but requires redesign.

key_decisions: Eq zone formula = compat_disj AND conjList(ih_exist_formula for each ssn : NF (k'+1) 3)
Until/Since zones CANNOT use same approach — formula must be changed
key_findings: NfComposition.lean line 23-36: formal counterexample proving 1-var NF compositionality FALSE for n>=2 on general linear orders (including Prior structures): M=(Z,<), env1=(0,2), env2=(0,1), k=1
The between-zone (t < y < x for Until) is the fundamental barrier — pairwise 1-var NF information does not determine whether elements of specific types exist in specific intervals
nf_extend_fwd/bwd always lose one depth level (K+1 arity r -> K arity r+1), making recursive composition impossible at the target depth
ExistPart signature is architecturally limited: parent_atoms : AtomKind sig 1 -> Bool enforces constant parent env, preventing encoding of [x,t] pair conditions
Approach (A) is likely the cleanest: define GeneralizedExistPart with parent env of arbitrary arity m, then Until/Since zones become the m=2 case with parent atoms encoding the full [x,t] pair
